from solution import even_bit_toggle_number


def test_issue_example_10():
    """Check example 'assert even_bit_toggle_number(10) == 15'."""
    # 10=0b1010, mask=0b0101=5, 10 ^ 5 = 15
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(10) == 15


def test_issue_one_to_zero():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 1 (0b1) to 0."""
    # 1=0b1, mask=0b1=1, 1 ^ 1 = 0
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(1) == 0


def test_issue_two_to_three():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 2 (0b10) to 3."""
    # 2=0b10, mask=0b01=1, 2 ^ 1 = 3
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(2) == 3


def test_issue_five_to_zero():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 5 (0b101) to 0."""
    # 5=0b101, mask=0b101=5, 5 ^ 5 = 0
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(5) == 0


def test_issue_seven_to_two():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 7 (0b111) to 2."""
    # 7=0b111, mask=0b101=5, 7 ^ 5 = 2
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(7) == 2


def test_issue_eight_to_thirteen():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 8 (0b1000) to 13."""
    # 8=0b1000, mask=0b0101=5, 8 ^ 5 = 13
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(8) == 13


def test_issue_fifteen_to_ten():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 15 (0b1111) to 10."""
    # 15=0b1111, mask=0b0101=5, 15 ^ 5 = 10
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(15) == 10


def test_issue_full_byte_255():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 255 (0xFF) to 170."""
    # 255=0b11111111, mask=0b01010101=85, 255 ^ 85 = 170
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(255) == 170


def test_issue_boundary_256():
    """Check 'toggle all odd bits' maps 256 (0b100000000) to 85."""
    # 256=0b100000000, mask=0b101010101=341, 256 ^ 341 = 85
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(256) == 85


def test_contract_callable():
    """Check public interface 'def even_bit_toggle_number(n)' is callable."""
    assert callable(even_bit_toggle_number)


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Check documented example result type is int."""
    assert isinstance(even_bit_toggle_number(10), int)


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Check 'even_bit_toggle_number(n)' gives same result for same input."""
    assert even_bit_toggle_number(10) == even_bit_toggle_number(10)
